posts.content_md:
Yes. There was some movement during exposure, thats why the pear is incomplete when tilting the hologram. Exposure was 10 minutes btw. My setup is way too complicated anyway. Dave (holomaker) has been telling me that for a long time, but I wasnt listening. 

Next time I just lay the object on the table, superglue 3 nails around it, and lay the DCGplate on the tips of those nails. Then illumination from the top. Superstable, setup of the pros ...
